question: The Indian Constitution originally consisted of how many Articles?
solution:
The correct answer is __**395**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Constitution of India originally consisted of **395 Articles** divided into 22 Parts and 8 Schedules when it was adopted on 26 November 1949.
 
• The Indian Constitution is one of the **longest written constitutions** in the world.
 
• It came into effect on **26 January 1950**, celebrated annually as Republic Day in India.
 
• Over time, the Constitution has undergone several amendments, and as of 2023, there are **470 Articles** divided into 25 Parts and 12 Schedules.
 
• The framing of the Constitution was led by the **Constituent Assembly**, chaired by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, who is also known as the "Father of the Indian Constitution."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Parts of the Constitution:** Initially, the Constitution had 22 Parts which outlined the framework of governance, fundamental rights, directive principles, and other provisions.
 
• **Schedules:** The original 8 Schedules provided detailed information regarding languages, allocation of powers, and more. Now, the Constitution includes 12 Schedules.
 
• **Amendments:** The Constitution has been amended multiple times. The first amendment was enacted in 1951, and as of 2023, there are 105 amendments.
 
• **Drafting Process:** The drafting of the Constitution took around 2 years, 11 months, and 18 days. The final draft was adopted on 26 November 1949.
 
• **Significance:** The Indian Constitution is unique as it incorporates features from various global constitutions, such as the parliamentary system from the UK, the federal structure from the USA, and directive principles from Ireland.
